source_basis: Exact retained original-data calculations; all values and memberships remain in companion CSVs.

figures.title: Changing sampling coverage, 2021–2025
figures.caption: 729 routine observations at 36 stations; one field replicate is kept separately. Eleven stations recur in all five years and contribute 450 routine observations. First appearance is within this retained source edition. The five Georgia repeat-panel stations have only Information Only comments in 2025; excluding those comments leaves six SC stations represented in all years.
figures.alt: Two panels compare original routine-record counts and station counts by year, including the repeated panel and stations first appearing in this source.

figures.title: SV-833: the sampled calendar changes the comparison
figures.caption: The original all-date medians are 419.6→387.3 MPN/100 mL (9 and 11 records). Restricting both years to January, February, April, May, July, August, November and December gives 298.9→666.8 (8 records in each year). Lines connect endpoint summaries only. These selected medians have exact original interval bounds; no inferential confidence intervals or management effects are implied. Matching months does not match exact dates, weather or flow.
figures.alt: Two median series reverse direction: all dates decrease slightly, whereas equal common-month support increases.

figures.title: USGS-02177000: original discharge and microbial sampling
figures.caption: 365 original 2022 daily means and all 16 microbial sample dates at the same station. All sample-date flow qualifiers are A; the seven-day window before 8 March contains four original A;e values. No microbial sample date reaches the annual 95th-percentile daily discharge (1,284 ft3/s). Filled markers are 14 numeric observations; open triangles mark the original limit for two non-detects, with vertical 0–20 censoring bounds. The prior window contains seven complete days and excludes the sample date. Source censoring bounds are distinct from confidence intervals; daily mean flow is context for these concentration observations.
figures.alt: An annual daily-flow curve with sample dates, followed by two concentration-versus-flow panels preserving both non-detect bounds and original flow qualifiers.
